Landing practice that worked: basicly worktree merge LANE --bead R --delivery pr from the main checkout; the lane engine form (uv run --project ../basicly.worktrees/LANE --directory . ...) when the tool says the lane changes the engine; a lane must start at a branch (worktree create --base main), be linear, and its recorded branch is the one landed. Since 2gtixnl (f612ad3c) the tool waits for every pull_request workflow, but a lane engine whose base predates f612ad3c still merges early; read gh run list on the PR head after each merge. Announce LANDING START and END to basicly-meta, basicly-audit and basicly-ux; no shared git config write during a landing. Local runs: one test file per pytest call, no 2>&1 before kdrlpaz (landed), no test sets.

payload.acceptance_criteria: When the job mods on newest Claude Code runs the scripts tests, the test sends no key after the prompt when the wait for the end of the turn passes its limit shall pass on three runs of one commit.
payload.description:
## Context

basicly-gates run 46030924364 attempt 1 (pin PR #58, a marketplace.json-only commit) failed in the job mods on newest Claude Code: the scripts test sends no key after the prompt when the wait for the end of the turn passes its limit (live.test.mjs, 996 ms) failed; attempt 2 of the same commit passed. A timing test that fails on one run of an unchanged commit.

## Steps to Reproduce

Run the job mods on newest Claude Code of basicly-gates on any commit; attempt 1 of run 46030924364 failed, attempt 2 passed.

## Confirmation Plan

Read the test and its time limit; make the wait deterministic with the fake clock or a wider limit with a reason; CI green on three runs.
payload.title: scripts: make the live helper turn-end wait test pass on the newest Claude Code runner
